8d6675903693b968bdc753860536d0e4.overview: A cynical TV weatherman, along with his idealistic producer and his sardonic cameraman, is sent to report on Groundhog Day in the small town of Punxsutawney, where he finds himself repeating the same day over and over.
8d6675903693b968bdc753860536d0e4.tagline: He’s having the worst day of his life… Over and over again.

8d67659b3be2fd824dcdb2829ef854c8.overview: The story of Elwood P. Dowd who makes friends with a spirit taking the form of a human-sized rabbit named Harvey that only he sees (and a few privileged others on occasion also.) After his sister tries to commit him to a mental institution, a comedy of errors ensues. Elwood and Harvey become the catalysts for a family mending its wounds and for romance blossoming in unexpected places.
8d67659b3be2fd824dcdb2829ef854c8.tagline: The Wonderful Pulitzer Prize Play … becomes one of the Great Motion Pictures of our Time!

8d779ef83185ea12826676356215dfa2.overview: This performance piece by filmmaker Hollis Frampton, recorded in 1968 in New York City, features the voice of artist Michael Snow. Frampton would place a tape deck at the front of a room, press play, and walk to the back to run a 16mm projector. Presented here is the audio portion of the piece, recreated with images designed to replicate Frampton’s visuals.

8d8779fb122cb08be1d9093473062594.overview: The story of Venezuelan revolutionary, Ilich Ramirez Sanchez, who founded a worldwide terrorist organization and raided the OPEC headquarters in 1975 before being caught by the French police.
8d8779fb122cb08be1d9093473062594.tagline: The man who hijacked the world

8da20c352389010b0240d7e9c591d30e.overview: Two young missionaries are forced to prove their faith when they knock on the wrong door and are greeted by a diabolical Mr. Reed, becoming ensnared in his deadly game of cat-and-mouse.

8da2567fc40cbcf2997e3c3755009adc.overview: A snobbish phonetics professor agrees to a wager that he can take a flower girl and make her presentable in high society.
8da2567fc40cbcf2997e3c3755009adc.tagline: The loverliest motion picture of them all!

8dd56b073e625ae1871eac0518ada7dd.overview: A rollicking compendium of the greatest hits of silent-cinema chase sequences
8dd56b073e625ae1871eac0518ada7dd.tagline: For the thrill of your life be sure to catch...

8de906d6a1a2568aabfbd8705435f04b.overview: Julie Messinger, a repressed woman, grapples with her hidden passions when a routine hospital visit for her husband, Richard, spirals into chaos. As secrets unravel, her quest for authenticity clashes with societal expectations.
8de906d6a1a2568aabfbd8705435f04b.tagline: The little black book that became a national best-seller.
